debts.title: Agent-scoping RLS policies compare users.id FKs against auth.uid()
debts.description_es: is_admin() ya se corrigió a auth_user_id (TD fix 2026-06-15), pero el resto de políticas de scoping de agentes siguen usando `<fk> = auth.uid()` (p. ej. listing_agent_id, assigned_agent_id, agent_id), donde esas FKs apuntan a users.id. create-agent inserta users.id = gen_random_uuid() ≠ auth_user_id, así que para un agente users.id ≠ auth.uid() y esas políticas nunca coinciden: un agente no vería sus propios datos. Latente hoy (solo existe el admin, 0 propiedades/clientes).
debts.description_en: is_admin() is now fixed to auth_user_id (fix 2026-06-15), but the remaining agent-scoping policies still use `<fk> = auth.uid()` (e.g. listing_agent_id, assigned_agent_id, agent_id) where those FKs reference users.id. create-agent inserts users.id = gen_random_uuid() ≠ auth_user_id, so for an agent users.id ≠ auth.uid() and those policies never match: an agent would not see their own data. Latent today (only the admin exists, 0 properties/clients).
debts.proposed_fix_es: Decidir modelo canónico: (A) alinear users.id = auth_user_id (y que create-agent inserte id = auth uid), o (B) reescribir las políticas para resolver el agente vía users.auth_user_id = auth.uid(). Aplicar antes de crear el primer agente real.
debts.proposed_fix_en: Decide canonical model: (A) align users.id = auth_user_id (and have create-agent insert id = auth uid), or (B) rewrite policies to resolve the agent via users.auth_user_id = auth.uid(). Apply before the first real agent is created.

resolved.title: Legacy FastAPI backend unused by dashboard
resolved.resolution_es: Auditoría confirmó que ningún servicio vivo consume el backend FastAPI (prod = Netlify + Supabase Edge Functions + whatsapp-gateway slim). Eliminados backend/ (91 archivos), gateway/ viejo (8), código muerto del dashboard (api.ts + proxy /api en next.config.js) y docker-compose.yml. Actualizados README.md y .env.example a la arquitectura Fase 8.
resolved.resolution_en: Audit confirmed no live service consumes the FastAPI backend (prod = Netlify + Supabase Edge Functions + slim whatsapp-gateway). Removed backend/ (91 files), legacy gateway/ (8), dashboard dead code (api.ts + /api proxy in next.config.js) and docker-compose.yml. Updated README.md and .env.example to Fase 8 architecture.
